text:
Maya: Thanks everyone for the all-hands segment on reliability — quick thread to capture the RCA and next steps. RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-0423. Please confirm owners for action items and flag blockers by EOD.
Priya: Got it. Can you paste the exact SLO hit window? I only saw rolling spikes on the dashboard and want to correlate with deploys.
Maya: SLO hit was ~3.2% error rate between 02:10–02:45 UTC. 99p tail latency spiked to ~1.8s. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/incident/2145. Root cause summary in RCA: cache invalidation + model-routing fallback edge-case.
James: I'll take the cache invalidation fix (action #42). ETA: tomorrow EOD. Do we want to revert the last deploy in the meantime? cc @Oliver
Oliver: Prefer canary revert of the model-routing change rather than a full revert. I can run a canary in the morning and monitor. Need a short runbook entry for the steps.
Priya: Adding the runbook entry now and will create a short verification checklist (post-deploy smoke tests in CI). Expect PR in ~2h.
Anjali: For roadmap/comms — does the routing tweak remain long-term? We should include behavior change in the release notes if so.
Maya: Yes, the tweak is intentional but we're throttling rollout until metrics are stable. We'll include notes and a brief blurb for customers.
SRE Bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 -> RCA published. Created actions: #42 (cache fix) assign: James; #43 (canary revert) assign: Oliver; #44 (runbook + CI smoke) assign: Priya.
James: Confirmed assignment for #42. I'll update the ticket with checkpoints and link to the PR. :thumbsup:
Priya: Scheduling a short sync tomorrow 9:30 PT for handoff and verification steps. @Maya FYI.
Oliver: I'll prepare the canary plan and traffic split config. If we see error rate >1% during canary, we rollback automatically.
Maya: Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. I'll mark this thread as active follow-up; we'll close after owners confirm fixes live. Closing window: 48h unless new issues. :white_check_mark:
